title: Advanced Counting & Windows
description: Core concepts and hands-on practice in Advanced Counting & Windows.

topics.title: K-th Value by Counting
topics.description: Search the numeric value rather than the index, using count <= mid. Includes guided dry runs, Java 17 implementation, independent practice, and interview transfer.

pages.title: Why This Topic Matters
pages.content: Search the numeric value rather than the index, using count <= mid.
pages.teachingGoal: Explain why K-th Value by Counting is useful.

pages.title: Intuition
pages.content: Start from a brute-force mental model, then ask what structure lets us remove half the candidates. State the invariant before writing the loop.
pages.teachingGoal: Explain the intuition for K-th Value by Counting.
pages.suggestedVisual: Candidate interval shrinking from two sides.

pages.title: Worked Example 1
pages.teachingGoal: Trace the first example of K-th Value by Counting.

pages.title: Worked Example 2
pages.teachingGoal: Trace a second variation and compare its boundary rule.

pages.title: Debugging Clinic
pages.content: Test empty/small input where allowed, target at an endpoint, target absent, repeated values where relevant, and the largest numeric answer. Never change a pointer without preserving the invariant.
pages.teachingGoal: Debug common K-th Value by Counting failures.

pages.title: Mastery Gate
pages.content: Explain the candidate space, predicate/order, boundary convention, termination, and complexity. Then solve one nearby problem without looking at the worked code.
pages.teachingGoal: Pass the mastery gate for K-th Value by Counting.
